'''Mojo''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone trooper]] [[Clone Captain/Legends|captain]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], Captain Mojo was assigned to a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] task force, consisting of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], [[Bruu Jun-Fan]], [[Grohto]], [[Ko Solok]], and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Tatsu]], commissioned to hunt down the newly resurrected [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and his brother, [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]].
